standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Chow Homology, the lemma on the pullback along a base change of the base scheme, its compatibility with Chern classes, and the splitting principle for vector bundles on projective space bundles
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the commutation of the cycle class map with base change to the agreement of first Chern classes, which is one of the hypotheses.

standard_prerequisites.name: Uniqueness of the degree map determined by axiom (A6)
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the remark on the trace map, and the construction in the proof of axiom (A6)

core_obligations: Linear algebra principles (proof lines 5478-5530): isomorphisms, injectivity, and the existence of a linear form pairing a tensor to a given vector are all detected after tensoring with the extension field; these principles give axioms (A1), (A3), (A5), (A7) and (A8) directly from the corresponding axioms for the extended data, and give axioms (A2) and (A4) once the commutativity of the Chern class diagrams and the injectivity of the canonical map to the tensor product are used.

Compatibility of the cycle class map (proof lines 5532-5573): writing the cycle class map in terms of the Chern character of a K theory class, and using compatibility of the base change map on Chow groups with capping by Chern classes, shows that the commutativity of the cycle class map with base change reduces to the agreement of the Chern classes of vector bundles, which by the projective space bundle formula and the splitting principle reduces to the agreement of first Chern classes assumed in the statement.

Axioms (A6) and (A9) (proof lines 5575-5616): the existence statement in axiom (A6) is equivalent after base change by the linear algebra criterion; the class of the diagonal decomposes under the Kunneth isomorphism, and the compatibility of that decomposition together with the base change compatibility of the cycle class map shows that the needed component is preserved; the degree maps are determined by axiom (A6), so the compatibility just obtained transfers axiom (A9) by a diagram chase.
proof_roadmap: Apply the linear algebra principles to transfer the axioms of isomorphism, injectivity and pairing type.
Prove compatibility of the cycle class map with base change via Chern characters and the splitting principle.
Transfer axioms (A6) and (A9) using the Kunneth decomposition of the diagonal and the uniqueness of the degree map.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that if the cohomology theory over the larger field satisfies axioms (A1) to (A9), then so does the theory over the smaller field, given compatible data and compatible Chern class diagrams (statement lines 5444-5474). The proof (proof lines 5475-5616) transfers the axioms one by one, using linear algebra principles for the formal axioms, a Chern character and splitting principle argument for the compatibility of the cycle class map, and the Kunneth decomposition of the diagonal for the two remaining axioms. H3: a long axiom by axiom verification with several independent arguments, written out in full.
